title: Creative Crossroads
head-description: Discover Creative Crossroads, a PRG initiative that highlights game art through video showcases, events, and exhibitions.
head-keywords: Creative Crossroads, PRG, game art, game development, showcases, events, exhibitions, Pori
og-description: Explore game art and the creative processes behind it through Creative Crossroads showcases, events, and exhibitions.
intro-description: Alongside developing ALT Zone, PRG ry has created a new initiative called Creative Crossroads. It highlights the role of game art in game development and gives artists a platform to share their work beyond our own ALT Zone project.
intro-description2: Creative Crossroads began with a desire to bring game art to a wider audience. We see game development as a collaboration between technology and art, and we wanted to give creators outside our own projects a place to showcase their work.
purpose-description: We want to share finished work, early ideas, and projects in development, along with the creative processes behind them. We also want Creative Crossroads to bring together people from the games industry, the arts, science, and a range of communities.
aimed-at-description: Anyone can take part in Creative Crossroads. You might be a game or sound designer, a programmer, a visual artist, a writer, a researcher, or someone curious about the artistic side of games.
showcase-title: Showcases – bringing game art to a wider audience
showcase-description: Our showcases feature audiovisual work submitted by artists who share what they made and the thinking behind it. We publish the work we receive on our YouTube channel.
events-description: Much of our activity takes place on YouTube, and we also organise events. These include discussions, seminars, exhibitions, workshops, and events that showcase and promote work in the games industry.
events-description2: Anyone can use the Creative Crossroads format at their own events to showcase game art related to the event's theme.
event1-details: Held at the Pori City Living Room in collaboration with IGDA Satakunta, PoriES, and Ars Pori.
event2-details: At the Pori City Living Room / Ars Pori Gallery. Open to the public with free admission.
event4-details: At the Pori City Living Room / Ars Pori Gallery. Open to the public with free admission.
join-description: Want to get involved, submit your own showcase video, or learn more about Creative Crossroads and our upcoming events?
followus-description: Follow the Creative Crossroads channels for project news and the latest updates from Pitchaamo.
prg-title: Learn more about PRG and its other projects.
